package.description: Dashboard for various tools and system monitoring, mostly for MSI (Micro-Star International) hardware.

en-GB.description: Dashboard for various tools and system monitoring, mostly for MSI (Micro-Star International) hardware.
en-GB.longDescription:
Dashboard for various tools and system monitoring, mostly for MSI (Micro-Star International) hardware.

Note that in an attempt to make Winget better detect MSI Centre available updates / existing installations, this package partially uses the metadata of MSI Centre SDK, which is installed when first running the MSI Centre app post-installation.

Though most of the features require MSI hardware, at least 2 features can be used on any PC as of July 2026 (System Diagnosis, and MSI AI Engine).
en-GB.name: MSI Centre (SDK + App)
